name: fling-wheel
title: Fling prize wheel
summary: A six-colour prize wheel: a horizontal drag turns it, and a fast release keeps it spinning until it decelerates to a stop.
prompt: Make a prize wheel I can spin with a swipe; it should keep spinning after I let go and slow down to a stop.
teaches: Make a value fling: touchExpression with expression ["touchX()"] and touchMode 0 (gently) carries the release velocity on and eases to a stop
Wrap an angle by leaving out min: max 360 makes the value wrap instead of clamp
Rotate a group of draws by the touch value with save { rotate(angle, pivot) ... }

snippets.note: angle follows the horizontal drag (1 px = 1 degree), wraps at 360, and keeps going on a fast release

@s = (min(componentWidth(), componentHeight()) - 60) / 240, then translate to the live centre (componentWidth() / 2, componentHeight() / 2 + 10) and scale by @s, so the wheel drawn at a fixed 120 radius fits any box
save + rotate(@angle) around the six drawSector calls, about the origin the outer save moved to the wheel centre
the fixed pointer: a small triangle built with pathCreate / pathAppendLineTo / pathAppendClose

check.describe: A 100 px drag released at 1000 px/s keeps the wheel turning for about two seconds after the release; at 3 s and at 4 s the frames are identical (settled). Resized, the wheel stays centred and scales with the smaller side (radius (min(w, h) - 60) / 2): smaller at 195×300, centred in the wide 450×200 box, with the pointer still on top; the same fling spins it the same angle, since a pixel is a degree at any size.

pitfalls: The fling velocity is found by perturbing touchX() inside the expression array itself: ["touchX()"] flings, but a single infix element such as ["touchX() * 2"] compiles to a separate expression and releases with zero velocity
Leaving out min turns on wrap mode (around max); min 0 clamps instead
drawPath with an inline SVG string is padded to 1024 floats (about 4 KB) by the Java parser; build small shapes with pathCreate / pathAppendLineTo so the document stays small and byte-identical
Draw the pointer after the save block: everything inside save { rotate } turns with the wheel, everything after it stays put

Draw a canvas around a translated centre and scale it from componentWidth()/componentHeight() rather than placing it at the header size literal coordinates (150, 160): the rotate pivot then is just the origin, and the drawing fits any box
